you already know which era dressed like armor. open The Runway and find it — the black snake-motif bodysuit, built defiant on purpose. reply with the era.

twelve closets, debut boots to showgirl sequins. longlivets.com/?lens=fashion&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread-fashion
why: Calendar 2026-08-25 15:00Z X, thread:fashion:interactive-challenge (The Runway X leg), hook 'direct address' — a different entry point into Monday's IG sister-eras challenge, not a truncation (subject is the reputation look, not the folklore/evermore pair, so it diverges well past >20%). Interactive-challenge: names one specific thing to find in The Runway and asks for the answer in replies. Source: apps/web/lib/longlive/lenses.ts RUNWAY_LOOKS look-reputation ('Armored Monochrome') — 'a black snake-motif bodysuit designed by Fausto Puglisi for Roberto Cavalli, built for the 2018 reputation Stadium Tour — armored, high-contrast, and defiant by design'; the twelve looks run debut ('curls & cowboy boots') to tloas ('orange sequins/showgirl'). The reputation look is genuinely present on the fashion lens, so the challenge is answerable on the live product. Media: /social/library/thread-fashion-screen.png (site-screen, product surface — fine on X, which has no aspect-ratio bar; NOT used on IG where its 780x1688 ratio would fail). Link /?lens=fashion (lens id confirmed at lenses.ts:102). Weighted length 228 (<=270). Shares Monday's IG campaign value per its stated intent (same Runway window = one IG + one X sibling story); idempotency is platform+campaign so an X post sharing an IG campaign never false-skips. Blocklist-safe (wardrobe/tour costume).
